observations: The page number «4» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L01-L13 end the passage on the conversion table begun on p. 3 (JP2 0035, L17); the square bracket that closes it stands in L13, «habebis]», and note 8 says that O omits what is enclosed.

L14: the chapter heading, «Cap. 3. De numerorum praescriptionibus.», in bold, centred; in the left margin «M 84r» beside it and «N 10r» beside L15. L20: the vertical bar between «portionum15)» and «singuli» marks the beginning of fol. 159 recto of O, which the note in the left margin, «O 159r», names; Suter says on p. X (JP2 0014, L25-L27) that this leaf of O is bound out of place and belongs between fols. 99 and 100.
L19 and L24: the note numbers 12 and 22 are each printed twice, after the two words of the text to which the same note applies.

N06: «perag’e», the abbreviation of M as the edition prints it, with an apostrophe. N07: the bracket after the note number 24 is printed broken, its middle missing, so that it looks like a comma and a stroke; transcribed «24)». N05: the long dash before the note number 18 is printed in two pieces; transcribed as one.
The colon of L04 and the semicolon of L06 stand after the thin space of the edition (10 and 9 px measured).

the note numbers of the apparatus are followed by a round bracket, «17)», «19)»; after 18 a square bracket is printed
